assets.note: Only 3 real images in public/assets/. Most sections lack custom photography.

critical.title: No API authentication
critical.description: All 14 API routes are publicly accessible with no rate limiting or auth. AI endpoints can be abused.

critical.title: Contact form uses filesystem storage
critical.description: Saves to data/leads/contact-submissions.json. Vercel has an ephemeral filesystem — data is lost on each deployment.

moderate.title: Deprecated geminiService.ts still present
moderate.description: src/services/geminiService.ts is marked deprecated but still exists in codebase.

moderate.title: Mixed AI SDK usage
moderate.description: Some routes use @google/genai directly, others use @ai-sdk/google. Should standardize.

moderate.title: V1 components not cleaned up
moderate.description: V2 redesign is live on homepage but 35 V1 components still exist alongside V2 components.

moderate.title: Inner pages not redesigned
moderate.description: All service pages, blog, about, contact, pricing still use V1 styling.

minor.title: Very limited image assets
minor.description: Only 3 real images available in public/assets/

minor.title: Low test coverage
minor.description: Only 2 test files exist (validators.test.ts, pricingService.test.ts). No component tests.

minor.title: No schema markup on most pages
minor.description: StructuredData component exists but not widely implemented across service/location pages.
